evidence_scope: official XML syntax and draw-order examples only; no solver or particle arrays

entries.fact: drawextrude accepts an explicit extrude vector and vdp layers, including negative and positive offsets.
boundary drawextrude with layers 0,-0.5,-1,-1.5,-2 is followed by fluid fillbox.
boundary drawextrude with layers 0,-1,-2 is followed by fluid fillbox.
fluid is drawn before the closed wedge and the wedge uses positive layers 0,1,2,3; this is the opposite draw order from C082.

inference: For C082 boundary-before-fluid ordering, negative inward layers are the documented-compatible minimal direction to retain thickness without consuming the fluid-facing side.
